Fix What’s Holding Your Website Back

Website SEO Repair Services in the USA

Fix SEO Errors, Improve Search Visibility, and Get Your Website Back on Track

Is your website not ranking, losing traffic, or failing to appear properly in Google search results? A good-looking website can still have hidden SEO problems that affect crawling, indexing, rankings, and search visibility.

FixWebsiteIssues provides professional SEO repair services for businesses across the USA. We identify what is holding your website back and fix the technical and on-page issues affecting its search performance.

Common reasons people call us: a sudden ranking drop, pages that won’t index, broken links and redirects after a redesign, or technical errors flagged in Search Console. We work from what is actually wrong with your site, not a generic checklist, when we fix website SEO.

As an experienced SEO repair company, we focus on finding the root cause instead of applying temporary fixes.

No Long-Term Retainers | Project-Based SEO Repair | Nationwide Service

Book a Free Consultation

Since 2013

Website repair & SEO recovery experience

1,000+ Websites

Repaired across multiple industries

24/7 Support

Emergency help — call or text anytime

Since 2013

Houston-based, serving clients nationwide

Is Your Website Losing Rankings Because of SEO Problems?

Many SEO issues are not immediately visible to website owners. Your website may appear normal to visitors while search engines encounter problems crawling, understanding, or indexing important pages.

You may need website SEO repair if:

  • Your website is not ranking for important keywords
  • Pages are missing from Google search results
  • Organic traffic has suddenly declined
  • Google is indexing the wrong pages
  • Important pages are blocked from crawling
  • Broken links or redirect chains are affecting your site
  • Metadata or heading structures are incorrect
  • Your website has duplicate or conflicting content
  • Page speed and Core Web Vitals need improvement
  • Structured data or schema contains errors
  • A website migration affected rankings
  • You are experiencing unexplained SEO problems

These issues can limit your search visibility even when you have quality products, services, and content.

Get a Free SEO Review and Find Out What Is Holding Your Website Back

How We Work

What Working With Us Looks Like

01

Free Consultation

We look at your site in Search Console and a full crawl, and note what is limiting crawling, indexing and rankings.

02

Live Diagnosis

We schedule a live session (via phone, Zoom, or Google Meet) to walk you through the issues and explain what needs fixing.

03

Secure Backup

Before making any changes, we take a complete backup of your site to ensure your data is protected.

04

SEO Repairs

Most technical fixes are done within 1–3 business days. We test each change and confirm it in Search Console.

05

Ongoing Support

After the job is done, we offer guidance, reports, and optional ongoing support to keep your site running strong.

What Is SEO Repair?

SEO repair is the process of identifying and correcting problems that prevent a website from performing properly in search results.

Unlike a general SEO campaign focused primarily on ongoing growth, SEO repair services begin with the problems already affecting your website.

The goal may be to correct:

  • Technical SEO errors
  • Crawl and indexing problems
  • Broken internal links
  • Redirect issues
  • Duplicate pages and content conflicts
  • Metadata problems
  • Incorrect heading structures
  • Sitemap errors
  • Robots.txt issues
  • Schema and structured data errors
  • Website speed problems
  • Mobile usability issues
  • Poor site architecture

Once we identify the cause, we implement the appropriate fixes and review the website’s SEO structure.

Technical SEO Repair for Websites

Technical problems can prevent search engines from accessing or properly understanding your website.

Our technical SEO repair services can address issues involving crawlability, indexing, site architecture, page performance, redirects, structured data, and other technical elements.

We investigate the actual condition of your website rather than assuming that one issue is responsible for poor rankings.

Depending on your website, this may include:

Crawl and Indexing Repair

We review whether important pages can be crawled and indexed correctly and identify problems that may prevent search engines from processing them as intended.

Sitemap and Robots.txt Review

Incorrect sitemap or robots directives can create unnecessary barriers for search engines. We review these files and correct relevant issues.

Broken Links and Redirect Repair

Broken internal links and poorly configured redirects can affect both user experience and website structure. We identify and repair relevant errors, including unnecessary redirect chains.

Site Structure Improvements

A poorly organized website can make it harder for search engines and visitors to find important pages. We review internal linking, content hierarchy, and page relationships.

Schema and Structured Data Repair

Incorrect or broken structured data may prevent search engines from properly processing the information on your website. We review and fix applicable schema errors.

Website Speed and Performance Issues

Slow-loading pages can create usability and performance problems. We identify technical factors affecting speed and recommend or implement appropriate improvements.

Fix SEO Issues Affecting Your Rankings

If your website is not ranking, the problem may not be a lack of content or keywords.

Ranking problems can be connected to multiple SEO errors, including:

  • Pages that cannot be indexed
  • Incorrect canonical settings
  • Duplicate content conflicts
  • Broken redirects
  • Missing or weak metadata
  • Poor internal linking
  • Thin or poorly structured content
  • Technical website errors
  • Slow page performance
  • Mobile usability problems
  • Website changes or migrations
  • Lost or damaged page relationships

Our SEO troubleshooting process examines these areas to determine which issues require attention.

We do not simply provide a list of recommendations. When possible and within the project scope, we work on fixing the identified problems.

Google Ranking Repair After a Drop in Visibility

A sudden decline in rankings can be frustrating, especially when you do not know what changed.

Google ranking repair begins with investigating possible causes. These may include recent website updates, indexing changes, technical errors, content changes, redirect problems, or broader search changes.

We review your website’s current SEO condition and look for technical or on-page problems that may be contributing to lost visibility.

The goal is to identify what can be corrected and create a clear repair plan.

SEO results cannot be guaranteed, and rankings can be affected by many factors, including competition and search algorithm changes. However, fixing legitimate website and SEO problems is an important first step toward restoring a stronger technical foundation.

Website SEO Repair Without a Complete Redesign

You do not always need a new website because your SEO is underperforming.

In many cases, we can fix SEO issues within your existing website by correcting errors in the site’s structure, settings, content, internal links, and technical configuration.

This can help preserve your current website while addressing the problems affecting search performance.

Depending on the condition of your site, our work may involve:

  • Updating SEO settings
  • Correcting page-level optimization issues
  • Repairing broken URLs
  • Fixing redirects
  • Improving internal linking
  • Correcting indexing instructions
  • Updating XML sitemaps
  • Repairing schema
  • Improving page structure
  • Addressing website performance issues

If a larger website rebuild is genuinely necessary, we can explain why and identify the problems that cannot reasonably be solved through repair alone.

Get in touch

  • (+1) 832 266 7209
  • info@fixwebsiteissues.com
  • Houston, Texas — serving all 50 states
Free Consultation

Why WevTEC

  • No deposit — pay after it's fixed
  • Pay only after the work is done
  • Complete backup before any change
  • No long-term contracts
Getting Started

How to Get Started

Call us at 832-266-7209 or send your details through the form, and we will get back to you promptly.

We then schedule a live review by phone, Zoom or Google Meet. During that session we:

  • Go through your Search Console data and site structure with you
  • Explain which problems are hurting visibility and which don’t matter much
  • Give you a repair plan, a timeline and a price
  • Take a full backup before we change anything

SEO repair is project-based, with no long-term retainer. If you also want ongoing SEO afterward, we can discuss that separately.

Speak to a Website Expert Now
FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions About Website SEO Repair

Still have questions?

Call or text us anytime — real experts, 24/7.

(832) 266 7209
What are SEO repair services?

SEO repair services focus on identifying and fixing technical and on-page problems that may be affecting a website’s ability to perform in search results. This can include indexing, crawling, redirects, site structure, metadata, internal links, and other SEO issues.

How is website SEO repair different from regular SEO?

Website SEO repair focuses first on correcting existing problems. Regular SEO often involves ongoing activities designed to improve and expand long-term search visibility, such as content development, keyword targeting, and continuous optimization.

Can you fix SEO issues without rebuilding my website?

In many cases, yes. Technical and on-page SEO problems can often be corrected within an existing website. Whether this is possible depends on the website’s platform, structure, and the specific issues involved.

Why is my website not ranking on Google?

A website may not rank well for many reasons, including technical SEO errors, indexing problems, strong competition, poor keyword relevance, content issues, slow performance, or website changes. An SEO audit can help identify potential problems.

What types of SEO errors can you fix?

We can help with crawl and indexing issues, broken links, redirects, metadata, headings, internal linking, sitemaps, robots directives, schema, canonical issues, website structure, and other relevant technical SEO problems.

Our Website SEO Repair Process

1. SEO Audit and Problem Identification

We begin by reviewing your website to identify technical, indexing, structural, and on-page SEO problems.

2. Root Cause Analysis

We investigate what may be causing the issue instead of making random changes. This helps us prioritize the problems that are most relevant to your website’s search visibility.

3. Repair Plan

We determine which SEO errors can be fixed and outline the work required.

4. Technical SEO Repair

We correct relevant technical problems involving crawling, indexing, redirects, site structure, speed, and other applicable issues.

5. On-Page SEO Corrections

We review page titles, metadata, headings, internal links, content structure, and other on-page elements that may need repair.

6. Validation and Review

After the work is completed, we review the repaired areas and check whether the relevant SEO issues have been addressed.

SEO Repair for Organic Traffic Recovery

A decline in organic traffic can have many causes. Technical SEO problems are one possible reason, but content changes, competition, search updates, and other factors may also affect performance.

Our organic traffic recovery approach begins with an investigation.

We review relevant areas of the website to identify problems such as:

  • Lost or deindexed pages
  • Crawl errors
  • Redirect mistakes
  • Duplicate page conflicts
  • Changes to important content
  • Broken internal links
  • Technical barriers affecting search engines

Once we identify actionable problems, we can prioritize the repairs that may help restore your site’s ability to compete in search.

Search Visibility Repair for Modern Search

Search continues to evolve beyond traditional keyword matching. Search engines and AI-assisted systems increasingly rely on clear website structure, useful content, logical organization, and machine-readable information.

Our search visibility repair process can help improve the technical foundation of your website by addressing issues that make it difficult for search systems to understand your pages.

This includes reviewing:

  • Content organization
  • Heading hierarchy
  • Internal page relationships
  • Structured data
  • Metadata
  • Technical accessibility
  • Indexing signals
  • Page clarity and relevance

The objective is to create a cleaner, more understandable website structure for both users and search systems.

Common SEO Errors We Can Help Repair

Our SEO repair services can address a wide range of website problems, including:

  • Crawl errors
  • Indexing problems
  • Broken links
  • Redirect chains and loops
  • Incorrect redirects
  • Missing metadata
  • Duplicate metadata
  • Poor heading structure
  • Internal linking problems
  • XML sitemap errors
  • Robots.txt issues
  • Canonical problems
  • Duplicate content conflicts
  • Schema errors
  • Slow-loading pages
  • Mobile usability issues
  • Poor website structure
  • SEO issues after a website migration
  • Pages that have lost search visibility

Every website is different, so the repair process depends on the specific problems we find.

Why Choose Our SEO Repair Company?

Many businesses do not need another generic SEO package. They first need to understand why their website is underperforming.

That is where targeted SEO repair can help.

Our approach focuses on:

  • Finding actual SEO problems
  • Investigating the root cause
  • Prioritizing important technical issues
  • Fixing applicable errors
  • Improving website structure
  • Providing a clearer understanding of what was repaired
  • Avoiding unnecessary long-term contracts for one-time repair work

We provide project-based support for businesses that need help addressing specific SEO and website issues.

Houston-Based Team Serving Clients Nationwide

Our team is based in Houston, Texas, and provides website SEO repair services for businesses throughout the United States.

Wherever your business is located, we can review your website remotely and help identify SEO issues affecting its performance.

Location may affect your competition, but technical SEO problems can happen to any website.

Do You Need SEO Repair or Ongoing SEO?

SEO repair and ongoing SEO are not the same service.

You May Need SEO Repair If:

  • Your rankings suddenly dropped
  • Your website has indexing or crawl problems
  • Important pages disappeared from Google
  • A redesign or migration caused SEO issues
  • Your site contains broken links or redirect problems
  • You need to identify and fix technical SEO errors
  • Your website is not performing as expected

You May Need Ongoing SEO If:

  • Your website’s technical foundation is already healthy
  • You want to create new content consistently
  • You are targeting additional keywords or locations
  • You want long-term organic growth
  • You need ongoing competitive analysis and optimization

Some businesses need both. We can start by identifying whether your immediate problem is something that requires SEO troubleshooting and repair before developing a broader SEO strategy.

Stop Losing Search Visibility to Fixable SEO Problems

If your website is struggling with indexing issues, technical errors, broken links, poor structure, or unexplained ranking problems, it may be time to investigate what is happening.

Our SEO repair services are designed to identify and address the website issues that may be limiting your search performance.

You do not have to commit to a long-term SEO retainer just to find out what is wrong.
